findings.observation: The frozen local artifact closes the recruiter-controlled loop, but it does not compare completion time, correction burden, or stale-action rate against the recruiter's manual note, ATS, message, and calendar fallback.
findings.evidence: TS-V1-FINAL-20260824-04 artifact.json explicitly lists design-partner recruiter field comparison and authorized candidate-side research as known missing proof; the executable bundle is synthetic-only.
findings.user_impact: Release can be judged operationally safe and coherent in the frozen local scope, but claims that it is faster or more useful than a practiced manual workflow would remain unearned.
findings.recommendation: Keep field-efficiency claims out of release language and run a design-partner comparison on the exact capture-to-recovery loop.
findings.verification: Representative independent recruiters complete seeded normal, ambiguity, interruption, response-loss, and no-action cases in Talent Signal and their normal fallback; report time, corrections, context switches, duplicate work, and stale-action rate without candidate scoring.

strengths: Frozen-object verification passed before review: 195/195 source hashes, 39/39 evidence hashes, 21/21 screenshot hashes, source aggregate 76f34380d01a02ebe9f2d6f7a21f0d639aea7772a25e8a3e0a2a08f90aa6dabb, and repository commit 2c19567f2d3b0e8e6a986fb8b420f4ac5b9c7435 all match TS-V1-FINAL-20260824-04.

Restored evidence-review authority fails closed: RelationshipArchiveTests/testSupersededPersistenceFailureKeepsSessionTerminalGuard proves a failed superseded save remains readback-locked after relaunch, and the exact/newer readback tests prove only matching availability, review status, and authority review ID unlock while newer authority becomes terminal. RelationshipAskView exposes only Check current evidence in the locked state, and revalidation is called only after an explicit successful Ask.

Owned-action response loss is calm and recoverable: CandidateSignalUITests/testOwnedActionResponseLossRelaunchReconcilesWithoutSecondPost verifies one POST, one canonical receipt, removal of the duplicate Today attention row, revision 2 readback, no Waiting for review label, and no stale Proposal affordance. The locked, Today recovery, and reconciled screenshots make that transition inspectable.

Canonical state does not leave obsolete work open: pursuit-domain-runtime.json reports action_revision_supersedes_open_proposal=pass, while the backend marks older needs_review Proposals and pending items superseded in the same action-completion transaction and records an audit event.

Identity, deletion, and response-loss paths remain recruiter-legible: the same-name receipt preserves distinct Person/role/context IDs; the deletion receipt states server confirmation precedes local payload removal; Proposal and action unknown-outcome screens lock resubmission until canonical readback.

All 71 P0 assertions and 12 file proofs resolve to 23 unique dependencies under the Retest 04 evidence root, and every dependency is present in the 39-entry artifact evidence manifest; no transitive P0 reference escapes the frozen artifact.

Rubric profile is trigger relevance 3, capture burden 3, evidence review 3, state integrity 3, action usefulness 3, write safety 3, interruption recovery 3, and wedge discipline 3; the reported score is the minimum material dimension, not an average.
